nodes.label: data/scripts/README.md
nodes.summary: Index of the dissertation analysis scripts a01-a13; they read the frozen artifacts of run 2026-07-25_10-55-17 and write to data/outputs and data/img, never retraining.

nodes.label: frozen run artifacts
nodes.summary: Nothing regenerates masks, reprocesses data or retrains, because that would break the correspondence between the 15 checkpoints and the data that produced them.

nodes.label: data/scripts/_common.py
nodes.summary: Shared authority for the analysis scripts: puts codes.* on sys.path, resolves DATA_DIR, and re-exposes pipeline contracts (registry keys, checkpoint names, subject split) so no script re-derives them.

nodes.label: a01_landmark_scheme_census.py
nodes.summary: Counts images in the 43- versus 73-landmark scheme per subject; writes landmark_classification.csv and landmark_by_subject.csv.

nodes.label: a02_latency_fixed_batch.py
nodes.summary: Inference latency at fixed batch 4 with warm-up discarded and GPU synchronization; writes latency_fixed_batch.json.

nodes.label: a03_per_subject_wilcoxon_best.py
nodes.summary: Per-subject metrics and paired Wilcoxon over the best_*.pth weights — the secondary variant; exports evaluate_subject.

nodes.label: a04_figs_qualitative_and_anomaly.py
nodes.summary: Qualitative inference grid and the lateral-anomaly figure; depends on a01 and a09.

nodes.label: a05_distance_strata_and_pixels.py
nodes.summary: mIoU by distance stratum, pixels per class and the Spearman area-vs-IoU correlation; depends on a09.

nodes.label: a06_figs_convergence.py
nodes.summary: One convergence panel per architecture with the five fold curves.

nodes.label: a07_fig_pareto_frontier.py
nodes.summary: Speed / mIoU / VRAM trade-off frontier; depends on a02 and a10.

nodes.label: a08_boundary_metrics_hd95_nsd.py
nodes.summary: HD95 and NSD boundary metrics — deliberately NOT executed because MONAI is not installed; the limitation is declared rather than fabricated.

nodes.label: a09_per_subject_wilcoxon_final_epoch.py
nodes.summary: Per-subject metrics and Wilcoxon over the epoch-99 checkpoints — the primary variant the dissertation reports; imports evaluate_subject from a03.

nodes.label: a10_vram_isolated_probe.py
nodes.summary: Re-measures VRAM with the isolated probe on the real GPU; the evidence for UB-28 (isolated x3 bit-identical, drift <=0.12 MB).

nodes.label: a11_mask_defect_census.py
nodes.summary: Full-corpus census of the mask-derivation defect over 8074 images; the evidence for UB-27.

nodes.label: a12_figs_methodology.py
nodes.summary: The three methodology-chapter figures built from already-processed data; depends on a05.

nodes.label: a13_landmark_side_evidence.py
nodes.summary: Derives and validates the visible-side rule of the 43-landmark scheme; the evidence for UB-29 (99.9% image-side naming, two orthogonal monotonic signals).
